scope: Read-only stage evidence review; no engineering rerun

findings.title: Well-formed rejected END retaining scope is treated as terminal by Controller
findings.trigger: END with exact expected identity/seq/origin/refs, E_PROTOCOL, drained=true, scope_active=true, NONE/0 output. Codec returns response error unchanged, provenance_response_bound passes, Controller clears tracker and retires despite still-active hub scope. Existing malformed-END test only flips reserved byte192.

findings.title: Hub/reference rejection advertises drained when physical observation says not drained
findings.trigger: physical_observation_valid=true and physical_drained=false: END rejected with retained scope but make_response unconditionally sets DRAINED bit. CPU response_base also defaults drained=true. TB only supplies physical_drained=true.

findings.title: 32 typed identity slots have no request-drain reclamation
findings.trigger: Distinct full NumericIdentity per successive drained request allocates permanent typed slot. RELEASE/INVALIDATE/cancel never free typed_valid/occupied. 33rd identity cannot BEGIN even with no active owners; implement safe request-boundary reclamation without clearing event/command/session replay highwaters.

controller_stream_scope: C++ controlled-response log reports maximum hls::stream depth400; does not demonstrate full production finite-depth2 progress or hardware fence.
